onboarding_subtitle: Your reference guide. Reopen it with ? or start the on-screen tour again.
onboarding_step_1_body: CC Suite Pro helps you review The Sims 4 Mods and custom content. This guide does not scan, delete, or move anything. Use the language selector above to choose your preferred language.
onboarding_step_2_body: On the Dashboard, choose Folder and select the Mods directory you want to inspect. Start with the included synthetic test folder if you are evaluating the app. Your library is never shared as part of the downloadable app.
onboarding_step_3_body: Select Refresh Scan to detect files. Check All Files, Duplicates, and Conflicts. A duplicate result needs human review; do not remove anything just because the app suggests it.
onboarding_step_4_body: The built-in classifier provides suggestions, not facts. The optional personalized model needs labels that you confirm. Review uncertain files before organizing or quarantining.
onboarding_step_5_body: Create a backup before changing your library. Saved scans are informational snapshots: run a fresh scan before using actions that move files. You can reopen this guide from the ? button at any time.
onboarding_save_failed: The tutorial preference could not be saved. Check your Windows profile permissions.
tour_step_1_body: This is your overview: library size, duplicate groups and scan status. The walkthrough only highlights controls; it never changes files.
tour_step_2_body: Use Choose Folder to select the folder you want to inspect. For a first test, use synthetic packages rather than your personal Mods.
tour_step_3_body: Refresh Scan reads the selected folder and updates the saved last scan. Scanning does not delete or move files.
tour_step_4_body: All Files shows detected files, categories and AI suggestions. Check filenames and locations before making changes.
tour_step_5_body: Duplicates groups identical files. Review each group carefully before deciding whether to quarantine a copy.
tour_step_6_body: AI Center offers suggestions for review, not automatic decisions. Optional personalized learning needs your confirmed labels.
tour_step_7_body: Organize previews proposed moves. Examine the preview and keep a backup before approving a change.
tour_step_8_body: Settings controls language, preferences and paths. The ? button opens Quick Guide whenever you need a reminder.
tour_step_9_body: Backup creates a separate copy before you move or quarantine Mods. The tour only points to this button; it never creates a backup automatically.
